stem_book: Solve the following equation (log denotes log base 10): 3^(log₂ log √x) − log x + log² x − 3 = 0.
reason: added the (standard) assumption that log means log base 10
work: L = log x > 0: (L/2)^(log₂3) + L² − L − 3 = 0; L = 2 ⇒ 1 + 4 − 2 − 3 = 0, LHS increasing past its negative part ⇒ unique ⇒ x = 100
